subject.description: VID of the party being granted access.

role.description: Role identifier interpreted by the ACL maintainer. Opaque to the framework.

scopes.description: Opaque scope identifiers (e.g. contexts, domains, resource prefixes).

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the entry.

expiresAt.description: Optional time after which this grant is no longer effective. Distinct from the framework's document-level expiresAt.

metadata.description: Ecosystem-defined extension members. Signed alongside the rest of the payload.

before.description: The AclEntry as it existed before this grant, or null if the subject was not present.

after.description: The AclEntry as it exists after the maintainer accepts this grant.

createdBy.description: VID of the party that originally added this entry.

updatedBy.description: VID of the party that last modified this entry.

Response.title: ACL Grant — response payload
Response.description: The success response to an acl/grant request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/acl/grant/1.0#response.

entry.description: The AclEntry that the maintainer now holds for the subject. MUST equal the request's payload.after.
